zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT z.zonecode as a_code, z.zonename as a_name, SUM("target") as "target", SUM("result") as "result", SUM("target1") as "target1", SUM("result1") as "result1" FROM cchangwat c INNER JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON SUBSTR(s.areacode, 1, 2) = c.changwatcode LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} JOIN chospital_regis as h ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode INNER JOIN czone as z ON c.zonecode = z.zonecode WHERE {{YYMMFREEZE}} and s.b_year = {{YEAR}} and ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) GROUP BY z.zonecode, z.zonename ORDER BY z.zonecode

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,   		 SUM(target) as target    ,SUM(result) as result     ,SUM(target1) as target1 ,SUM(result1) as result1     FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
